text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a short walk. After a quick breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work from home, so I follow a fixed schedule with short breaks every two hours. In the afternoon, I exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or doing yoga. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a series with my family. I go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent with this routine helps me feel healthy, focused, and relaxed.
